about: Shared by backend/tests/test_model_pricing.py and frontend/tests/lib/pricing.test.ts so the two estimators agree. A case's optional `wired` lists input ports with an edge into them. The `table` node is a five-route table (services/node_route.py routes): its price entry keys each route by its `pricing` or id, `runCases` price a whole run (estimate_run / summarizeRunScope) with the keys in `apiKeys`, and `routeEstimateCases` give each route's price (estimate_routes / estimateRoutes). A route entry with `unconfirmed: true` is a price the provider's page doesn't state exactly (the switcher marks it with *; route_price_unconfirmed / routePriceUnconfirmed). The `moded` node prices by `(mode)`, a price variable read from the wired ports (v2v with start_video, i2v with start_image, keyframes or end_image, else t2v; model_pricing.VIDEO_MODE / pricing.ts VIDEO_MODE), and `tooled` by run-time quantities of its source clip ((source seconds), (output megapixels): RUN_TIME_VARIABLES), so it is unpriced before the run. `shippedRouteCases` price the registry's route-table nodes with the shipped table (backend/data/model_pricing.json): each route's price as a number, a [low, high] range, or null. `shippedRunCases` price a whole run of a registry node on the shipped table (estimate_run / summarizeRunScope) with the keys in `apiKeys` and the ports in `wired` (one edge each). Krea 3 also prices by `(references)`, read from the wired ports: `some` with an edge into `images`, else `none` (model_pricing.REFERENCES / pricing.ts REFERENCES).
